Root cause: syncGoalWeights wiped all weights BEFORE the list_goals fetch, so a fetch miss or a dry-run mid-await zeroed the queue; passDry never re-synced. Fixed: no pre-fetch reset, passDry re-syncs, rank_why on each row, ticket tiebreaker. Proven live: back-to-back dry-runs identical; weight-10 goal moved queued BEB-3856 3->10 to the top in-call; rank_why present = new code running.
- BB Docs chain re-asserted as a w10 goal: 2495/9155/9154/9159 now rank weight-10 in would_claim; 9168 weight-10 behind the concurrency cap (981 queued, 15 in-flight) — drains checker-first as slots free.
- GD field research: local sqlite GD bench (no docker), custom FIELD + custom POST TYPE created via wp-admin handlers, 23 field types + DB model + can/cannot. Two corpus docs render live on docs.abilifi.net/d/6a35fd08 and /d/a1106856 (BlockNote, resolved by me).
- bbdocs-okf-spec graphed (markdown canonical, wiki-render over Cap'n Web, import/export, docs off Supabase per 9170).

FINDING (m67009): attempt rows can't hash the input — only prompt_head + a head-compare flag, no spec_ref/base_sha/config/full-prompt. So 9173 (capture input) before 6791 (comparator).

REDS I saw: BEB-9168 PROPOSED_NEVER_CLAIMED 6 passes — now explained (concurrency cap + was unboosted; now w10). m67007: 3615 model-rotation gates 9168's checker (builder==checker today).

NEXT per the queue: loop drains the boosted chain; 3615 lands before 9168. Blocks go on tickets as rows.
